A #id written in the same write that declares its question is indexed by the drain, not the write: settlement makes the question's ask after the version is indexed, and the version's trigger owes the document's scope, so the next tick (immediately at start, then every 30 s, or 2 s while a batch is full) re-indexes the citing text.
The editor scans without the question map, so `#q2-` in the editor hides its trailing `-` inside the drawn title while the renderer trims it (known since plan v1).
deviations: Production fixtures are in SMOKE, not LEGSMOKE: production Dispatch has no LEGSMOKE project and SMOKE is Legion's smoke project there. Creating a project needs a person, so A8 runs on SMOKE.
